tools.name: search_seeds
tools.description: Search for Balatro seeds. Describe what you want in natural language (Jummy) like 'what: Negative Perkeo in ante 1', or pass a JAML filter with deck, stake, must/should/mustNot clauses. Supports jokers, vouchers, bosses, tags, editions, stickers, and more. Randomly samples up to 1,000,000 seeds.

jummy.description: Natural language seed search. Example: 'what: Negative Perkeo in ante 1'

tools.name: analyze_seed
tools.description: Inspect a specific Balatro seed. Returns boss blinds, tags, vouchers, shop items, and booster packs for each ante (1-8). Use after search_seeds to drill into a promising seed.

jaml.description: JAML filter JSON for deck/stake context. Minimal: {"deck":"Red","stake":"White"}
